caption: The drawing depicts a pair of shoes positioned side by side, with both shoes oriented with their toes facing slightly downward and to the right. The shoes are made of a green fabric featuring a white, intricate floral brocade pattern that covers the surface. Each shoe has a large, overlapping tongue or flap across the instep, secured in place, and the opening is filled with white or off-white tissue or cloth, which creates the appearance of fullness. The soles and edges of the shoes are outlined with a darker color, possibly black or dark brown, and the shoes cast faint shadows on the plain, beige background. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a handwritten note in cursive that reads, "Brocade Shoes 18th Century." The entire composition is surrounded by a simple, unadorned, light-colored space that highlights the central shoes.
title: Brocade Shoes
